A1.justification: Both PDFs describe OverLoCK and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–D. Matching content across layout and citation changes supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original OverLoCK experiments on ImageNet-1K, COCO and ADE20K, including component ablations, robustness evaluations and visualization analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in the main text and appendices. Retention from v1 does not change their empirical status.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the DDS architecture, Base-Net/Overview-Net/Focus-Net roles, context-prior updates, GDSA, ContMix, auxiliary supervision and model configurations. The revised abstract and diagram styling do not introduce a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet-1K, COCO 2017, ADE20K and the ImageNet-V2/A/R/Sketch benchmarks. Higher-resolution classification and the visualization scenarios already appear in v1's appendices.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding main-text and appendix comparisons. Table 7 retains DyConv, ODConv, Involution, VOLO, DCNv3, Shifted Window and Natten. Newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The classification, detection, segmentation and ablation protocols match, including 300-epoch classification training, COCO 1×/3× schedules, 120-epoch classification ablations and 30-epoch high-resolution fine-tuning. Throughput measurement remains on an NVIDIA L40S with batch size 128.

E4.justification: The component roadmap, token-mixer comparisons, kernel-size, stage-ratio, channel-reduction, auxiliary-loss and ContMix ablations are retained. OOD robustness and ERF/Grad-CAM analyses also remain unchanged in the appendices.

E5.justification: Neither version provides run/seed counts, confidence intervals or significance tests for the benchmark results. The existing image-averaging descriptions for ERF visualization are unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched numerical entries and rankings in Tables 2–7 and A–I are unchanged. For example, OverLoCK-T retains 84.2% ImageNet-1K accuracy and OverLoCK-B retains 86.2% at 384×384 resolution. The visualizations retain the same qualitative findings.

T1.justification: The affinity construction, dynamic-kernel normalization and context-prior update equations are unchanged. No mathematical definition, derivation, assumption or proof is substantively added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: v3's abstract explicitly claims the first pure ConvNet backbone architecture incorporating top-down attention, strengthening v1's claim of a novel backbone. The DDS/ContMix contributions and headline performance claims otherwise retain their scope.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning global context, local inductive bias, top-down guidance, recurrent architectures, robustness and ablation tradeoffs are retained. No substantive limitation or applicability boundary is added.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the advertised code-access link from bit.ly/4bdbmdl to bit.ly/OverLoCK. Implementation, hyperparameter and hardware disclosures otherwise match. The PDFs establish an access-pointer update, not a verified change in the underlying code resource.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations to SegMan, SparX, TransXNet and ConvNeXt V2 while retaining the earlier cited works and broad research positioning. Its abstract also makes the priority claim explicit. Bibliography alphabetization and citation renumbering are presentation changes.

P1.justification: The abstract is rewritten to explain the three subnetworks directly, with limited editing elsewhere and unchanged section organization. Section 3.1 corrects references to Figure 4, but Appendix A incorrectly changes Table A to Table 6, and Appendix C changes Table I to Table 1.

P2.justification: Figures 3–5 receive lighter typography and line styling. Tables 2–7 move from PDF pages 7–8 to pages 6–7, with accompanying text reflow and added page numbers. The table structures and scientific visual content are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 clarifies the architecture in the abstract and corrects method figure references, but introduces incorrect appendix table references and strengthens the priority claim without additional justification. With the method and empirical evidence unchanged, these mixed editorial and positioning changes do not establish a reliable net improvement or deterioration.
